THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: KN/DS/PNY/AQ/WPP/PH-02/49. Min. Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/53.

I hereby give notice, under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Descriptions of the land or servitude to be acquired: Plan No. : CM 920083; Block No. : 08; Sheet No. : 16: Situation Village : Veddukkadu; GN Division : Paramankirai (KN/67); DS Division : Poonakary; District : Kilinochchi; Province : Northern; 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Illagaddichoolai; Description : Garden; Name of the claimant : Not known; Extent : 1.9550 Hectares

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land : Illagaddichoolai; Description : Garden; Name of the claimant : Not known; Extent : 0.0075 Hectares All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, poonakary 27.01.2025 at 9.30 a.m. ested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20.01.2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. T. Akilan, Divisional Secretary, Poonakary. At the Divisional Secretariat Poonakary. On this 09th day of December, 2024,
